jobs.title: Conservation Ranger, National Parks and Wildlife Service
jobs.employer: NPWS (Department of Housing, Local Government and Heritage)
jobs.location: Nationwide, Republic of Ireland (includes Dublin, Cork, Galway)
requirements: Experience in wildlife management or nature conservation (volunteering and placements count)
Strong interest in wildlife and nature conservation
Good IT and report writing skills
Full driving licence (a UK licence must be exchanged if living in Ireland)
jobs.about: Field-based ranger doing species and habitat monitoring, conservation management, Wildlife Acts work and public engagement.
jobs.how_to_apply: Online application on publicjobs.ie by 3pm, 19 November
gaps: Irish driving licence (exchange of her UK licence, if she moves to Ireland)

Experience with volunteers and the public helpful

jobs.how_to_apply: Online on the TCV vacancy page, quoting ID357

jobs.title: Fisheries Officer
jobs.salary: €33,127 to €48,136, plus an unsocial hours allowance of up to €7,979
jobs.contract: Permanent, full-time (39-hour week including weekends, evenings and nights)
requirements: Leaving Certificate or recognised equivalent
Full Category B driving licence valid in Ireland
Competent in and on the water, at sea and on lakes and rivers
Strong interest in conserving natural resources; must live within 60 minutes' drive of base
jobs.about: Mostly outdoors role patrolling rivers, lakes and coast, with habitat improvement, electro-fishing, fish surveys, pollution sampling and enforcement work.
jobs.how_to_apply: Cover letter and CV through the listing by 5pm, 26 November
gaps: On-water competence (a short powerboat or water safety course covers this)
Irish driving licence (exchange of her UK licence, if she moves to Ireland)
